title: Scene
description: Scene definition (production/scenes/<SC_ID>/scene.yaml): slugline, synopsis, entities present, and the ordered beat list that /shot-list and /smart-shot break into coverage.

synopsis.description: What happens in the scene and why it matters, in a short paragraph.

location.description: Location bible this scene plays in.

time_of_day.description: Story time of day; continuity-state and lighting derive from it.

weather.description: Weather condition, if it matters on screen (e.g. steady rain).

props.description: Props visible or used in the scene.

beats.description: Ordered beat IDs (beat.schema.json); every shot's narrative purpose maps back to one of these.

estimated_duration_seconds.description: Rough on-screen duration target used for shot timing budgets.

script_excerpt.description: Optional verbatim excerpt from the screenplay this scene realizes.
